description: MainActivity.java for an Android app implementing geofencing with Google Play Services; manages geofence creation, connection handling, and geofence transition intents.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity managing geofence setup and GoogleApiClient connection for geofencing.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes GoogleApiClient, checks Google Play services, and creates geofences.

methods.name: createGeofences
methods.description: Creates and stores predefined geofences for specific locations.

methods.name: onConnectionFailed
methods.description: Handles failure to connect to Google Play services, attempts resolution if possible.

methods.name: onConnected
methods.description: Adds geofences via LocationServices API once connected.

methods.name: onConnectionSuspended
methods.description: Removes geofences if connection is suspended.

methods.name: isGooglePlayServicesAvailable
methods.description: Checks availability of Google Play services.

methods.name: getGeofenceTransitionPendingIntent
methods.description: Creates PendingIntent to trigger GeofenceTransitionsIntentService on geofence transition.
